title: Traeger Black Garlic Braised Portobellos
description: Thin portobello slices take on oak smoke before a covered braise turns their black garlic broth into a glossy pan sauce.
equipment: Small shallow metal baking pan and foil

ingredients.name: fresh portobello mushroom caps
ingredients.note: Trimmed weight, cut across the caps into 1/4-inch slices.

steps.title: Heat the smoker
steps.text: Preheat the Traeger Silverton 610 to 300°F with oak pellets for about 15 minutes, following its startup cycle.

steps.title: Mix the braising liquid
steps.text: Whisk {broth}, {garlic}, {thyme} and {oil} together in a small shallow metal pan.

steps.title: Add the mushrooms
steps.text: Toss {mushrooms} in the braising liquid and spread the slices in an even layer.

steps.title: Take on smoke
steps.text: Cook the pan uncovered on the Traeger for 15 minutes with the smoker lid shut. The bottom of the pan should stay wet.

steps.title: Cover and braise
steps.text: Seal the pan with foil at the 15-minute mark. There is no stall or wrap temperature for vegetables. Braise for 25–35 minutes until the slices bend easily around a fork.

steps.title: Rest the mushrooms
steps.text: Rest the pan covered off the smoker for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Glaze the slices
steps.text: Slide the mushrooms and pan juices into the HexClad skillet over medium heat. Stir in the slurry and simmer for 1–2 minutes until the glossy juices cling to the slices.

notes: Make ahead: Trim and slice the mushrooms a day ahead and refrigerate. Braise them ahead if desired and thicken the sauce at serving time. Refrigerate in shallow portions within 2 hours and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. The sliced mushrooms freeze well in their braising liquid for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: Warm a portion in its sauce in a covered skillet over medium-low heat for 5–8 minutes. Stir until smooth and 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw in the refrigerator overnight, then follow the fridge reheat instructions. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 72 kcal, 3.8 g protein, 9.5 g total carbohydrate, 2.8 g fat, 2.1 g fiber, 20 mg sodium.
